cash_flow_data_explanation.overview: This Statement of Cash Flows was generated using the indirect method, drawing from two primary data sources: QuickBooks Online (QBO) and WildApricot. The report period is January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025.

quickbooks_data.summary: QuickBooks provided the Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss report for the period ending December 31, 2025. The Profit & Loss report returned null values for Total Income, Total Expenses, and Net Income, indicating no income or expense transactions were recorded in QuickBooks during the 2025 fiscal year. The Balance Sheet shows a single asset — a Checking account with a balance of $5,000.00 — funded entirely by Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00. No liabilities, no accumulated depreciation, no fixed assets, and no loan balances were present in the QuickBooks data.

profit_and_loss_highlights.note: All P&L values returned null from QuickBooks. Net Income is treated as $0.00 for cash flow purposes.

wildapricot_data.summary: WildApricot provided invoice, payment, event registration, event, donation, and contact data fetched on 2026-06-26. Importantly, all WildApricot invoice and payment activity falls outside the QuickBooks report period of 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Invoice dates range from 2026-04-02 to 2026-06-24, and payment dates range from 2025-08-05 to 2026-06-25. Only one payment — $250.00 from 'Testing, Scott' on 2025-08-05 — falls within the 2025 fiscal year. However, this payment has no corresponding invoice in the 2025 period and cannot be matched to a QuickBooks balance sheet account without fabrication. It is disclosed as a note item only.

invoices.period_overlap_with_report: None — all invoices are dated in 2026, outside the 2025 fiscal year report period.

payments_within_report_period_2025.note: This single $250.00 payment falls within the 2025 fiscal year. It is not matched to a QuickBooks balance sheet line item and is disclosed as an informational note. It is not included in the cash flow statement to avoid fabricating unverifiable balance sheet impacts.

payments_outside_report_period.note: All remaining payments are dated April–June 2026 and fall outside the 2025 report period. They are excluded from this statement.

event_registrations.note: Event registration PaidSum values were not available in the source data. No dollar amounts can be attributed to event registrations without fabrication. All event registration dates fall in 2026, outside the report period.

donations.note: No date was provided for this donation. It cannot be confirmed as falling within the 2025 fiscal year. It is excluded from the cash flow statement to avoid fabrication.

wildapricot_data.wildapricot_cash_flow_impact: Because all WildApricot invoice and payment activity with confirmed dates falls outside the 2025 report period (except the single $250.00 test payment noted above), no WildApricot-sourced adjustments to working capital (e.g., deferred membership revenue, accounts receivable from unpaid invoices) can be reliably incorporated into this 2025 cash flow statement without fabricating balance sheet beginning/ending balances that do not exist in the QuickBooks data.

cash_flow_data_explanation.summary: This Statement of Financial Position is derived from two primary data sources: QuickBooks (as of 2025-12-31) and WildApricot (fetched 2026-06-26). The QuickBooks Balance Sheet reports a single Checking account balance of $5,000.00 as the sole asset, with no liabilities recorded and equity composed entirely of Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00. The Profit & Loss report returned null values for all income and expense fields, indicating either no activity was recorded in QuickBooks for the period or the report was not yet populated. WildApricot data covers invoices, payments, donations, event registrations, and events for the organization (Account ID: 497705). WildApricot invoices total $9,108.00 across 48 records (42 paid = $7,948.00; 6 unpaid = $1,160.00), spanning April–June 2026 — which falls outside the QuickBooks report period of 2025-12-31. As a result, WildApricot activity cannot be directly posted to the 2025-12-31 balance sheet without a reconciliation adjustment. The 6 unpaid WildApricot invoices ($1,160.00) represent potential Accounts Receivable, but since they are dated in 2026, they are excluded from the 2025-12-31 balance sheet. WildApricot payments total $8,738.00 across 46 records; one payment of $250.00 dates to 2025-08-05 (Testing, Scott — Invoice #106800163), which is within the fiscal year but lacks a corresponding QuickBooks entry. Event registrations show 3 paid and 3 free registrations with no dollar amounts specified in PaidSum fields, and the single donation of $10.00 (Brian Rorabaugh) has no corresponding QuickBooks entry. Due to these data gaps and the date misalignment between QuickBooks (period ending 2025-12-31) and WildApricot (activity in 2026), the balance sheet reflects only the QuickBooks-confirmed figures. All WildApricot-sourced amounts are flagged for management review and reconciliation before inclusion in audited financials.

The single 2025 WildApricot payment ($250.00, August 2025) is noted but is not separately broken out on the balance sheet because it is presumed already captured within the QuickBooks Checking balance of $5,000.00 or represents a prior-period item not yet reconciled. scheduleO.narrative: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild Inc. promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community events, and member support. The Guild provides hands-on classes, workshops, special interest groups (SIGs), and resources to woodworkers of all skill levels in the Kansas City metropolitan area. Programs include the Rough to Ready beginner woodworking series, Basic and Intermediate Woodworking classes, Bandsaw Box, Project Finishing, and specialty SIGs covering CNC, Carving, Hand Tools, Finishing, and Laser Engraving. The Guild also hosts monthly membership meetings and participates in community events such as the National Craft Open Studios Weekend.

The organization does not currently have a formal documented process for governing body review of Form 990 prior to filing. The Treasurer reviews financial data and prepares or oversees preparation of the return. The organization intends to implement a formal review process in future tax years.

The organization makes its governing documents and financial statements available to the public upon written request directed to the Treasurer at 1717 Washington St, Kansas City, MO 64108-1121. The organization does not currently post these documents on a public website.

Prior period adjustment of $4,740.00 represents the difference between the QuickBooks Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00 (end-of-year net assets per Part X) and the $260.00 excess of current-year revenue over expenses (Part XI Line 3). The Opening Balance Equity recorded in QuickBooks reflects funds established at or before the start of the 2025 tax year for which beginning-of-year balance sheet data was not available in the source system. This amount is reported as a prior period adjustment to reconcile beginning net assets of $0.00 (as reported due to unavailable prior-year data) to the QuickBooks-confirmed end-of-year net assets of $5,000.00.

This report is generated for tax year 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. QuickBooks data reflects a single Checking account balance of $5,000.00 recorded as the end-of-year asset, with Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00 as the sole equity entry. No liabilities, no additional asset accounts, no income, and no expense figures were present in the QuickBooks Profit & Loss or Balance Sheet reports for this period (all P&L totals returned null). WildApricot data covers invoices, payments, donations, event registrations, and events; however, the vast majority of WildApricot transaction dates fall in 2026 (April–June 2026). Only one WildApricot payment of $250.00 is dated within the 2025 tax year (payment ID 106800163, dated 2025-08-05, Testing, Scott — MembershipApplication), and one donation of $10.00 from Brian Rorabaugh (no confirmed date) was recognized as a 2025 contribution. Because the WildApricot invoice and payment records are predominantly outside the 2025 tax year, they cannot be mapped to 2025 balance sheet or cash flow line items without a corresponding QuickBooks accrual entry. The single confirmed 2025 WildApricot payment ($250.00, August 2025) is presumed captured within the QuickBooks Checking balance of $5,000.00 or represents a prior-period item not yet reconciled in QuickBooks. WildApricot unpaid invoices totaling $1,160.00 (6 records) are all dated 2026 and do not affect the 2025 year-end accounts receivable balance. No deferred revenue from prepaid memberships or events attributable to the 2025 tax year could be confirmed from the available data. Beginning-of-year (2025-01-01) balances are not available in the source data and are reported as $0.00. All figures are traceable directly to QuickBooks Balance Sheet totals and WildApricot payment records unless otherwise noted. Data quality flags: (1) Beginning-of-year balances set to $0.00 due to unavailability in QuickBooks source data. (2) QuickBooks Profit & Loss report returned all null totals; net income for 2025 cannot be confirmed from QuickBooks and is derived solely from WildApricot 2025-dated transactions ($260.00 total revenue, $0.00 expenses). (3) WildApricot invoice and payment records dated April–June 2026 are excluded from 2025 reporting. (4) One WildApricot payment of $250.00 dated 2025-08-05 (Testing, Scott) falls within the tax year but lacks a corresponding QuickBooks account mapping; assumed included in Checking balance. (5) No QuickBooks liability accounts were present; all liability lines reported as $0.00. (6) Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00 is mapped to Net Assets Without Donor Restrictions as the only available equity figure. (7) WildApricot donation of $10.00 (Brian Rorabaugh) has no confirmed date in source data; recognized as 2025 revenue based on available information but excluded from balance sheet mapping pending reconciliation.

generatedTaxReturnDraft.cash_flow_data_explanation: The cash flow data presented in this return is derived from two source systems: QuickBooks (accounting records) and WildApricot (membership and donation platform). QuickBooks provided a Balance Sheet as of 2025-12-31 reflecting a single Checking account balance of $5,000.00 and Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00; the QuickBooks Profit & Loss report returned null values for all income and expense line items for the period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, indicating no transactions were posted to income or expense accounts in QuickBooks during the tax year. WildApricot provided invoice, payment, donation, and event registration records; of these, only two transactions fall within the 2025 tax year — a membership dues payment of $250.00 dated 2025-08-05 (Testing, Scott — payment ID 106800163) and a donation of $10.00 from Brian Rorabaugh (date unconfirmed). All remaining WildApricot transactions are dated April through June 2026 and are excluded from 2025 reporting. The $5,000.00 Checking balance in QuickBooks represents the sole confirmed cash position at year-end and is reported on Part X Line 1 as Cash — non-interest-bearing. The $260.00 in WildApricot-sourced revenue ($250.00 membership dues plus $10.00 donation) is reported in Part VIII but has not been confirmed as posted to QuickBooks; a reconciling difference of $260.00 exists between Part VIII Total Revenue and QuickBooks Total Income. No operating cash outflows were recorded in QuickBooks or WildApricot for the 2025 tax year, resulting in Part IX Total Expenses of $0.00. Beginning-of-year cash and net asset balances are reported as $0.00 due to the absence of prior-year QuickBooks data. All figures are directly traceable to QuickBooks Balance Sheet totals or WildApricot payment records as identified above.
